mission_objective_own_words: We are building the governed substrate where verified work compounds and nothing silently disappears; this merge lands the design-block library on main cleanly under the Scorecard Law.
proof_standard: Done means the ref moved only after tools/verify_gitdata_merge_tree.py exited 0 on the exact tip, CI is green on that same tip, and an independent seat's scorecard receipt at 9.0 or higher is recorded.

relevant_domains.why_this_task: The assignment is a merge, and Domain 8 owns merge mechanics: verify the tree mechanically before moving the ref, because tree=head-tree silently drops base changes.
Merging also touches the engineering truth law inside Domain 8: green CI on the exact tip before the ref moves, with the tree verified against a real local merge.
Merging under the Scorecard Law means no ref moves without a 9.0+ independent scorecard receipt. That is Domain 5.4; merging without the protocol is the violation.
